# Orbit job-application tracker (code.in.30s)
Clean minimal BENTO dashboard web app for students and new grads tracking internship / job applications. Rounded 20px cards on a calm background, generous whitespace, thin 1px hairline borders, no heavy shadows. Space Grotesk bold headings and big numerals, Geist for UI text. Deep forest green #1F4D3A primary, ONE lime accent #C6F35E for highlights (active nav pill, key stat, chart bar of current week, primary CTA text on green). Status colours: Wishlist slate, Applied blue-grey, Interview lime, Offer forest green, Rejected muted coral #E07A5F. Company logos are simple coloured letter monograms. No photos, no people, no neon, no gradients-heavy glassmorphism.
## Light: background off-white #F6F5F0, cards white #FFFFFF with #E6E4DC border, ink #14181A, muted #5E6660.

screens.name: projects/2270660294596355138/screens/c4953531482648bfa3cc27a64b7c4b46
screens.prompt:
Desktop 1440px wide clean minimal BENTO dashboard for Orbit, a job & internship application tracker for students and new grads. Light mode aesthetic: background off-white #F6F5F0, cards white with 1px #E6E4DC hairline border, 20px rounded corners, crisp spacing, no heavy drop shadows.

Color Palette:
- Background: #F6F5F0
- Card Surface: #FFFFFF, border 1px solid #E6E4DC, border-radius 20px
- Primary: Deep forest green #1F4D3A (buttons, active badges, accents)
- Accent: Lime #C6F35E (highlight cards, active bars, interview badges)
- Ink / Text: #14181A
- Muted Text: #5E6660
- Status Colors: Wishlist slate #8A948E, Applied #5B7C99, Interview lime #C6F35E (with dark forest text for contrast), Offer forest green #1F4D3A (with white text), Rejected coral #E07A5F

Typography:
- Headings & key metrics: Space Grotesk bold
- Body & interface labels: Geist / Inter sans-serif

Layout Structure:
1. Left Sidebar (w-60 / 240px fixed left, border-r border-[#E6E4DC] bg-white h-screen p-5 flex flex-col justify-between):
   - Header: Orbit ring mark logo (minimal concentric rings or orbital circle in #1F4D3A) + 'Orbit' wordmark in Space Grotesk bold, subtext 'Application Tracker'.
   - Nav list: Dashboard (active pill in #1F4D3A text-white or lime #C6F35E pill with #1F4D3A text), Board (kanban icon), Interviews (calendar icon), Settings (gear icon).
   - Bottom widget: 'Weekly goal' card (bg-[#F6F5F0] rounded-xl p-3.5 border border-[#E6E4DC]), showing '7/10 applications', progress bar filled 70% in #1F4D3A with lime tip, motivational subtext '3 more to hit your weekly target'.

2. Top Bar (sticky top-0 bg-[#F6F5F0]/80 backdrop-blur border-b border-[#E6E4DC] px-8 py-4 flex items-center justify-between ml-60):
   - Search input: Clean pill search box with search icon, placeholder 'Search companies, roles, tags…' (bg-white border border-[#E6E4DC] rounded-xl px-4 py-2 text-sm w-96).
   - Right actions: Notification bell icon with subtle unread dot, primary CTA button '+ Add application' (bg-[#1F4D3A] text-white px-4 py-2 rounded-xl font-medium hover:bg-[#16382a] flex items-center gap-2 shadow-sm), user avatar chip 'Aarav' with monogram 'A' in #1F4D3A bg-[#E6E4DC] rounded-full w-8 h-8 flex items-center justify-center font-bold text-xs.

3. Main Content Area (ml-60 p-8 max-w-7xl):
   - Welcome Header:
     - Left: 'Good morning, Aarav' in Space Grotesk bold 28px text-[#14181A], subtext 'Here is your recruiting progress for Fall 2025.'
     - Right: Date pill 'Sun, 25 Oct' in bg-white border border-[#E6E4DC] px-3.5 py-1.5 rounded-full text-sm font-medium text-[#5E6660] flex items-center gap-2.

   - Bento Grid Layout:
     Row 1: Four Stat KPI Cards (grid-cols-4 gap-5 mb-6):
       * Card 1: 'Total applied' -> 48 (Space Grotesk bold 32px), '+6 this week' badge in slate/green. White card, 20px radius.
       * Card 2: 'Interviews' -> 9 (Space Grotesk bold 32px), '2 scheduled this week' badge. White card.
       * Card 3: 'Offers' -> 2 (Space Grotesk bold 32px), 'Northwind, Quanta' badge in soft forest green pill. White card.
       * Card 4 (FEATURE ACCENT CARD): 'Response rate' -> 31% (Space Grotesk bold 32px), stylized lime #C6F35E background card with #1F4D3A text, clean circular progress ring chart showing 31% filled in forest green with sleek track, '+4.2% vs last month'.

     Row 2: Two Bento Cards (grid-cols-12 gap-5 mb-6):
       * Left (col-span-7): 'Applications per week' wide card (white bg, 20px radius, p-6 border border-[#E6E4DC]):
         - Header with title, subtitle 'Last 8 weeks volume', filter dropdown 'All roles'.
         - Sleek vertical bar chart for 8 weeks (W1 through W8) with application counts (e.g. 3, 5, 4, 7, 6, 8, 5, 10). The current week (W8) bar is highlighted in vibrant Lime #C6F35E with a badge '10 apps', while preceding weeks are muted slate/green bars. Clean horizontal guideline axes.
       * Right (col-span-5): 'Pipeline' breakdown card (white bg, 20px radius, p-6 border border-[#E6E4DC]):
         - Header 'Pipeline' with total '58 tracked roles'.
         - Horizontal segmented / stacked bar chart with precise proportions: Wishlist (12 - #8A948E slate), Applied (24 - #5B7C99 steel blue), Interview (9 - #C6F35E lime), Offer (2 - #1F4D3A forest green), Rejected (11 - #E07A5F coral).
         - Legend list below with color dots, stage names, counts, and percentages (e.g. Wishlist 12 · 21%, Applied 24 · 41%, Interview 9 · 16%, Offer 2 · 3%, Rejected 11 · 19%).

     Row 3: Two Bento Cards (grid-cols-12 gap-5):
       * Left (col-span-7): 'Upcoming interviews' (white bg, 20px radius, p-6 border border-[#E6E4DC]):
         - Header with 'Upcoming interviews' (3 scheduled) and 'View calendar' text link.
         - List of 3 rich interview cards:
           1. Northwind · Frontend Intern: company monogram [NW] (slate rounded square 40x40), title 'Frontend Intern', company 'Northwind', round 'Technical Round 2 (System Design)', date chip 'Tue 27 Oct · 10:30 AM' in lime badge with calendar icon, 'Prep notes' button.
           2. Quanta · SDE I: company monogram [Q] (emerald rounded square), title 'Software Engineer I', company 'Quanta', round 'Final Behavioral & Values', date chip 'Thu 29 Oct · 15:00' with date chip, 'Prep notes' button.
           3. Lumen · Product Designer: company monogram [L] (coral/ochre rounded square), title 'Product Designer (Design Systems)', company 'Lumen', round 'Portfolio Deep Dive', date chip 'Mon 2 Nov · 14:00', 'Prep notes' button.
       * Right (col-span-5): 'Recent activity' timeline card (white bg, 20px radius, p-6 border border-[#E6E4DC]):
         - Header 'Recent activity' with 'Live updates'.
         - Vertical timeline with connected dot rail:
           - Today 09:15: Status updated to 'Interview' for Northwind (Lime badge).
           - Yesterday: Applied to Pixelcraft · Junior Fullstack (Applied #5B7C99 badge).
           - 23 Oct: Offer letter received from Brightpath ($45/hr)! (Offer #1F4D3A badge).
           - 22 Oct: Added Fernwood to Wishlist (Wishlist #8A948E badge).
           - 20 Oct: Rejection received from Kite Labs (Rejected #E07A5F badge).

Design details:
- Monograms are simple crisp colored letter badges in rounded squares (e.g., [NW], [Q], [L], [P], [F], [BP]).
- Strictly no stock photos, no human faces, no placeholders that look like images.
- Pure elegant UI with exact color hexes and Space Grotesk / Geist styling.

outputComponents.text:
Here is the desktop **Bento Dashboard** for **Orbit**, an internship and job application tracker designed specifically for students and new grads.

### What was crafted:
1. **Light Minimal Bento Aesthetic**:
   - Built on a soft off-white canvas (`#F6F5F0`) with 20px rounded white cards encased in 1px hairline borders (`#E6E4DC`) and zero drop shadows.
   - Distinctive typography using Space Grotesk for bold metrics and section headlines, paired with Geist for clean, scannable interface typography.

2. **Left Navigation Sidebar (240px)**:
   - Minimal orbital ring brandmark with the **Orbit** wordmark.
   - Clean navigation links (*Dashboard*, *Board*, *Interviews*, *Settings*), with *Dashboard* highlighted in the active pill treatment.
   - Bottom widget featuring the user's **Weekly Goal (7/10 applications)** with an interactive visual progress bar and motivational feedback.

3. **Top Utility Bar**:
   - Universal search input with keyboard shortcut hint (`⌘K`), quick notification badge, primary deep forest green CTA (`+ Add application`), and Aarav's profile avatar.

4. **Bento Grid Layout**:
   - **4 Stat Cards**: *Total applied (48)*, *Interviews (9)*, *Offers (2)*, and the vibrant hero accent card for *Response rate (31%)* highlighted in lime (`#C6F35E`) with an integrated radial ring gauge.
   - **Applications per Week**: An 8-week volume bar chart with filter controls, spotlighting the current week (W8) in bright lime with a 10-app callout badge.
   - **Pipeline Breakdown**: Horizontal segmented bar paired with an itemized breakdown for each stage (*Wishlist (12)*, *Applied (24)*, *Interview (9)*, *Offer (2)*, and *Rejected (11)*).
   - **Upcoming Interviews**: Dedicated interview schedule cards for *Northwind*, *Quanta*, and *Lumen*, complete with custom letter monograms, time chips, and quick-action "Prep notes" triggers.
   - **Recent Activity Timeline**: Chronological event feed with stage badge accents mapping application state changes.

screens.prompt:
Design the "Board" (Kanban) screen for "Orbit", a student & new grad job & internship application tracker. Desktop 1440px wide layout.

Visual styling strictly adhering to the design specifications:
- Light mode: background off-white #F6F5F0, cards clean white with 1px border #E6E4DC, ink #14181A, muted text #5E6660, deep forest green #1F4D3A primary, lime accent #C6F35E.

- Typography: Space Grotesk for headings and counts, Geist or clean sans for UI body text.
- Status colors: Wishlist slate #8A948E, Applied slate blue #5B7C99, Interview lime #C6F35E (with dark ink text), Offer deep forest green #1F4D3A (with white text), Rejected coral #E07A5F.
- No photos, no people, no stock photography.

Layout & Structure:
1. Left Sidebar (w-60 / 240px fixed, white background, right border #E6E4DC):

   - Notification bell icon button.
   - Primary button "+ Add application" (bg-[#1F4D3A] text-white rounded-xl px-4 py-2 hover:opacity-95).
   - Profile avatar monogram "A" Aarav (aarav@orbit.app).

3. Main Content Area (Kanban Board):
   - Header:
     - Title "Board" in Space Grotesk bold text-2xl/3xl, subtitle "Manage and track application stages across active recruiting cycles."
     - Controls row:
       - Filter chips: 'All' (active dark/forest pill), 'Internship', 'Full-time', 'Remote' (pill chips with subtle border, rounded-full, px-3 py-1.5 text-xs font-medium).
       - Right controls: View toggle (Kanban Board icon active, List icon inactive), Sort dropdown ("Last updated"), and Search/Filter inline.
   - 5 Kanban Columns side by side (horizontal scroll or clean 5-column grid `grid grid-cols-5 gap-4`):
     1. Wishlist (3 roles) - Status dot #8A948E, title "Wishlist", count badge "3".
        - Card 1: Fernwood - Backend Systems Intern, "Fernwood", Bangalore / Hybrid, "₹50k/mo", "Added 2d ago". Monogram 'FW' in soft neutral square.
        - Card 2: Arcadia - AI Research Intern, "Arcadia", Remote, "₹75k/mo", "Added 4d ago". Monogram 'AR'.
        - Card 3: Stripe / FinTech lab - Product Operations Intern, "Stripe", Bengaluru, "₹40k/mo", "Added 1w ago".
        - Dashed "+ Add role" slot at bottom.
     2. Applied (5 roles) - Status dot #5B7C99, title "Applied", count badge "5".
        - Card 1: Pixelcraft - Junior Fullstack Developer, "Pixelcraft", Remote, "₹45k/mo", "Applied yesterday". Monogram 'PC'.
        - Card 2: Kite Labs - Frontend Engineer (New Grad), "Kite Labs", Gurgaon, "₹18-22 LPA", "Applied 3d ago". Monogram 'KL'.
        - Card 3: Databricks - Platform Engineer Intern, "Databricks", Bengaluru, "₹90k/mo", "Applied 5d ago".
        - Card 4: Razorpay - Associate Product Designer, "Razorpay", Bengaluru, "₹40k/mo", "Applied 1w ago".
        - Card 5: Postman - Developer Relations Intern, "Postman", Remote, "₹35k/mo", "Applied 1w ago".
        - Dashed "+ Add role" slot at bottom.
     3. Interview (3 roles) - Status dot #C6F35E, title "Interview", count badge "3".
        - Card 1: Northwind - Frontend Intern, "Northwind", Remote / Hybrid, "₹45k/mo", tag highlight: Lime pill badge "Interview Tue 10:30 AM" (bold, icon, lime #C6F35E bg with dark ink text), "Round 2: System & UI". Monogram 'NW'.
        - Card 2: Quanta - Software Engineer I, "Quanta", Bangalore, "₹20 LPA", tag "Behavioral · Thu 3 PM". Monogram 'Q'.
        - Card 3: Lumen - Product Designer, "Lumen", Remote, "₹55k/mo", tag "Portfolio Review · Mon 2 PM". Monogram 'L'.
        - Dashed "+ Add role" slot at bottom.
     4. Offer (1 role) - Status dot #1F4D3A, title "Offer", count badge "1".
        - Card 1: Brightpath - Software Engineering Co-op, "Brightpath", Bengaluru / Hybrid, "₹45/hr · Spring 2026", "Offer received Oct 23", badge "Decision deadline in 8d". Monogram 'BP'.
        - Dashed "+ Add role" slot at bottom.

Card styling details:
- Each card: rounded-[18px] bg-white border border-[#E6E4DC] p-4 flex flex-col gap-2.5 transition-all hover:border-[#14181A]/30 cursor-pointer.
- Monogram logos: rounded-xl w-8 h-8 flex items-center justify-center font-bold text-xs with muted distinct background tint (e.g. slate, teal, amber, neutral).
- Clear typography hierarchy: Role title (font-bold text-sm text-[#14181A]), company name (text-xs text-[#5E6660]), tags/chips row (location chip, salary chip in subtle pill badges bg-[#F6F5F0] text-[#5E6660] text-[11px] px-2 py-0.5 rounded-md), bottom timestamp or status highlight.

     * Applied: 14 Oct 2025 · via Referral link by Rohan S. (Completed checkmark)
     * Recruiter Screen: 20 Oct 2025 · 30m phone screen with Maya Lin (Completed checkmark)
     * Technical Round 2: Tue 27 Oct 2025 · 10:30 AM (Active glowing lime node / "Upcoming")

     * Devashish Roy · Staff Frontend Engineer / Panel Lead · Monogram "DR" in soft warm beige circle · "d.roy@northwind.tech" · Note: "Expect React concurrency & CSS architecture questions"
   - "+ Add interviewer contact"

5. Card 5: "Interview Notes & Prep" Bento Card:
